payload.posture: Read Genesis 49:22–26 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states vine, archers, strength, shepherd, stone, divine help, abundance, and separation from brothers converge in Jacob’s words over Joseph. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
payload.title: Jacob blesses Joseph as fruitful, attacked, and sustained
